body:
MODULE.bazel/BUILD.bazel added per founder sequencing ('bazel it first'). Hermetic bazel test //:syntax-check (bash -n, shellcheck not installed in sandbox). Non-hermetic bazel run //:run-flash / //:test wrappers, same split MISHRI already established. Two real Bazel gotchas found and fixed: target-name/source-file collision (renamed to :run-flash), and $RUNFILES_DIR path resolution (naive relative dirname doesn't work for the primary executable). bazel build //... clean, bazel test //:syntax-check passes, bazel run //:run-flash -- --version works. FLASH commit d2613da.

⚓ ☃
